title: SocialScience InterviewThematicAnalysis

stats.done_summary: Completed mixed-methods interview thematic analysis. Implemented reproducible preprocessing + descriptives (cohort counts, response length stats, term frequencies) and generated figures (length distribution, top terms, and—if LLM coding available—theme prevalence by cohort) under report/images/. Ran Anthropic Messages API (claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022) for thematic codebook + respondent-level multi-label coding; saved the full raw API response to outputs/anthropic_messages_response.json and parsed payload to outputs/thematic_codes.json. Computed transparent theme prevalence counts in Python and wrote publication-style report to report/report.md (also report/interview_thematic_report.md).
